text: Most of the week's 22 pull requests in microsoft/BCApps are behaviour-changing fixes. In warehouse and item tracking, #14240 stops the "Cannot match item tracking" error on partial Inventory Pick posting with Strict Expiration Posting, #13331 corrects lot assignment in Create Pick when breakbulk is off and FEFO is on, #14013 stops stale pick bins reaching warehouse shipment tracking on Transfer and Purchase-Return lines, and #13206 removes a serial number error when reversing a Capacity Ledger Entry. In finance and localisation, #13613 corrects Additional Currency amounts in Australian VAT/GST entries, #14297 sets German VAT reports to Exported after ELMA XML export, #13854 makes VAT Entries and the G/L - VAT Reconciliation report respect filters, #14225 fixes a credit memo regression for non-inventory items, #14184 stops one vendor's missing email clearing another's Document No., and #13904 adds unposted purchase returns and credit memos to Find Entries. #14139 gives Czech compensations separate customer and vendor lookup events, and #9193 locks Transformation Rule codes against translation. The Expense Agent gets configurable per diem rounding in #14136, an active approver field and navigation in #13673, and approval setup fixes in #13910 and #13927. #14405 renumbers three codeunits to avoid installation failures. Master Data Management gets clearer errors in #14400 and a duplicate-insert fix in #14077. Partner hooks arrive in #14346, with #14423 and #14327 as smaller changes.

issues: #14225 is described only as a 'credit memo regression'; it is specifically purchase credit memos failing on Get Return Shipment Lines for non-inventory items. Accurate but slightly vague.
#14405 sits right after the Expense Agent sentence but does not say the renumbered codeunits are Expense Agent codeunits (6913-6915 to 6923-6925); adding that would make it clearer.
#14346 'Partner hooks' could name Expense Management and the now-public Create Expense Report codeunit.
Word count is about 216, close to the 220 upper limit.
